title: Discount Authority on an Order Signed Before the Cap Tightened
scenario_text:
Vega Dynamics governs pricing through its Discount Approval Policy.

Version 1.0 (effective 2022-01-01) states: "Discounts up to and including 30% off list may be approved by the Sales Director. Discounts above 30% require VP of Sales approval."

Version 2.0 (effective 2024-06-01) states: "Discounts up to and including 20% off list may be approved by the Sales Director. Discounts above 20% require VP of Sales approval." It adds a transition clause: "Discount authority for an order is fixed by the policy version in effect on the date the order form is signed. Order forms signed before June 1, 2024 are governed by v1.0 for the full original term, including any co-terminous add-ons executed under that order form. Order forms signed on or after June 1, 2024 are governed by v2.0."

The CRM record for order form OF-2214 (customer: Northwind Freight) shows: Order Form Signed Date 2024-05-28, Term 24 months, Discount 26% off list, Booking Date recorded 2024-06-14, Approver field blank.

A deal desk analyst posts in #deal-approvals on 2024-06-17: "Cleaning up OF-2214, it's a 26% discount. It was signed May 28 but only got booked into the system on June 14, after the new 20% rule went live. Does this need VP of Sales sign-off, or can the Sales Director approve it?"

Using the policy history, the transition clause, and the CRM record, determine whose approval is required for the 26% discount on OF-2214.
question: Whose approval is required for the 26% discount on OF-2214?
choices: Sales Director approval is sufficient, because OF-2214 was signed 2024-05-28 under v1.0, whose 30% Sales Director threshold governs the order, and 26% falls below it.
VP of Sales approval is required, because v2.0 caps Sales Director authority at 20% off list and 26% exceeds that limit.
VP of Sales approval is required, because the order was booked on 2024-06-14, after v2.0 took effect on June 1, 2024.
Sales Director approval is sufficient, because v2.0 raised the Sales Director ceiling to 30% off list.
